name: Beatriz Oliveira
bio:
Beatriz's fascination with motorsport ignited during her childhood in Vila Real, watching the annual circuit races roar through the streets. She pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering at the University of Porto, focusing on precision manufacturing. After graduating, she honed her skills at a local engineering firm specializing in automotive components, quickly establishing herself as a meticulous and efficient machinist. Her reputation for unwavering precision led to an opportunity with Aston Martin, where she now plays a crucial role in crafting and maintaining the team's intricate components.

Beatriz thrives in high-pressure environments and approaches every task with a blend of technical expertise and creative problem-solving. She's known for her ability to diagnose complex mechanical issues quickly and devise effective solutions. Her dedication to quality and her calm demeanor under pressure make her a valuable asset to the Aston Martin team. She is particularly interested in applying new materials science to create more resilient and lighter parts for the car.

What sets Beatriz apart is her relentless pursuit of perfection and her deep understanding of how even the smallest component can impact overall performance. She's not just a machinist; she's an engineer who understands the nuances of racing and the importance of precision in every detail. She's constantly seeking ways to improve her skills and contribute to the team's success.
